{
  "name": "欧式单层L形住宅",
  "style": "european",
  "design_notes": "东翼向南伸出，与横向主屋组成L形平面。两翼均用双坡屋顶，入户门设在东翼东墙。",
  "floor_height": 7,
  "plinth": 1,
  "floors": [
    {
      "blocks": [[0, 0, 30, 14], [18, 14, 12, 16]],
      "doors": [{"block": 1, "side": "E", "at": 0.5, "width": 3}],
      "window": {"width": 3, "height": 4, "sill": 2, "gap": 4},
      "eave": false
    }
  ],
  "roof": {"type": "gable", "pitch": 40, "overhang": 1, "curve": false},
  "columns": null
}
